title.en: Tale 13 — The Ringdove and the Net

sentences.ar: سرب حمام كان طاير ورا حبة.
sentences.en: A flock of doves was flying after some grain.
They all landed on the ground and fell into a net.
Each dove began pulling its own way.
The net did not move at all.

sentences.ar: قالت الحمامة المطوقة: شدوا كلكم مع بعض.
sentences.en: The ringdove said: all of you pull together.
They pulled together and flew off with the whole net.
